name: Denia

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0.5 Whimpering Wastes (Hybrid)

kit.intro: 5-star Fusion Rectifier Hybrid highly specialized for exactly 2 archetypes: Fusion Burst (with Aemeath) and Tune Strain (with Luuk Herssen/Qingxiao), selectable via a configurable Resonance Mode. Two forms (Stagecraft -> Breakdown) switched via her two Ultimates; Breakdown Form's second Ultimate drops a persistent 30s 'Erosion Field' that periodically groups enemies and applies Fusion Burst/Tune Strain off-field.

skills.normalAttack: Dreamweaver's Banquet - separate 4-hit chains per form.
skills.resonanceSkill: Bubbles and Baits - Phantom Bubble (Stagecraft, pull) / Beckon-Banish (Breakdown, 2-part nuke consuming Dark Cores).
skills.forte: Shattered Hours / 'Flawless' - governs Void Particle/Conformal Charge/Dark Core resource flow between forms and Tune Break interactions.
skills.liberation: Final Act - Stagecraft variant switches her to Breakdown form (Entropy Shift, +30% ATK); Breakdown variant (2nd Ultimate) is the core damage/utility nuke that spawns the Erosion Field.
skills.intro: Formal Greetings - It's Been A While! (Stagecraft) / Knock Knock (Breakdown).
skills.outro: Unfinished Lies - Fusion Burst mode: +60% Fusion Burst DMG Amplify near active character for 30s. Tune Strain mode: next character gains 15% (40% if they apply Tune Strain) All-DMG Amplify for 16s.

bestWeapons: Waltz in Masquerade / Jinzhou Keeper (F2P craftable, mode-dependent)
echoSet: Chromatic Foam (best in Fusion Burst mode)
Reel of Spliced Memories (best in Tune Strain mode)

teams.name: Fusion Burst Team
teams.notes: Denia + Aemeath is one of the strongest teams in the game; Lupa (Moonlit Clouds) or Chisa fill 3rd slot.

teams.name: Tune Strain Team
teams.notes: Mornye is close to mandatory - Denia experiences significant DPS drop-off without her.

rotation: Standard: Intro -> Basic Stagecraft 4 -> Skill (Phantom Bubble, cancel) -> Ultimate (Stagecraft) -> Breakdown Basics 1-2 -> Mid-air Basics -> Skill (Banish 1-2, cancel) -> Ultimate (Breakdown) -> Outro. Opener variant (when Denia rotates first) pre-builds Stagecraft Forte via a full basic chain first.
communityNotes: Prydwen: top-tier (T0) Hybrid but extremely narrow - only functions in 2 specific team archetypes with essentially no flexibility outside them (unlike generalists like Lynae); requires switching between 3 different Echo Set builds depending on team. An easy, high-value pickup if you own Aemeath or Luuk/Qingxiao without a premium team already.
